channel.title: Daniel Scheidemantel Camargo — Writing
channel.description: Notes on applied AI engineering, cloud architecture and running systems in production.

item.title: AI is an accelerator, not a decision-maker
item.description: I build a platform whose job is running AI agents in production, and I have every commercial reason to say they are close to autonomous. They are not, and the gap does not close with a bigger model.

item.title: You have to be bad at something again
item.description: Competence is pleasant, and it is where learning quietly stops. What a new country does is expose your defaults as defaults — and you can trigger that without a plane ticket.

item.title: Planning a legacy migration: the rollout is the hard part
item.description: Writing the new system is the part you can estimate. Moving real traffic and real people onto it is where migrations actually die — and it is consistently planned last.
